receipt.timing_scope: Serial unpaced file replay. Per-frame time includes decoding, original undistort/crop, encoder input conversion/execution/patch extraction and learned stream processing/cache rebuild/BA. First three frames additionally include saved original dense encoder/patch-array validation and raw NPZ saving. Rejected FP32 gates remain visible and continue only under the explicit diagnostic flag. Native log capture/finite guards are included in encode time; SDK-specific timing remains separate. Model loading/source hashes and report I/O are outside per-frame time but inside driver elapsed; termination is separate offline work. Arrival timestamps are software file-read admission, not physical capture or paced queue latency. No P95 camera/20Hz claim.
